subject: AWS/GCP/Azure Marketplace private offer pricing — unit price mapping (BrightCart)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@brightcart.com>, AWS Marketplace Sales <aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: marketplace private offer discussion + quick ask on volumes/targets

Thanks for taking the call this morning, Ethan — great to meet. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can map the private-offer unit pricing across AWS/GCP/Azure and pull together a Marketplace Private Offer draft for BrightCart.

Recap (from our notes):
- Use case: chat + summarization for customer support (low-latency generation + embeddings for search).
- Target initial region: us-west (AWS), plan for multi-cloud later (GCP + Azure).
- Expected ramp: POC → production over 6-12 weeks.

Can you confirm the following so we can propose a target $/1M tokens and a Marketplace unit price mapping?
1) Estimated monthly token volume (range is fine): e.g. 1M-10M, 10M-50M, 50M-200M, etc.
2) Budget range for inference (monthly) during first 6 months.
3) Target unit economics: is there an internal target $/1M tokens you’re trying to hit for the private offer?
4) Preferred marketplace for the private offer (AWS / GCP / Azure) and whether procurement prefers a private-offer route or direct invoicing.

I’ve attached a pricing scenario spreadsheet (redwood-pricing-scenario.xlsx) that shows a few unit-price bands and what they net each month at various volumes — that should help surface the $/1M target you’re comfortable with.

Next steps: if you can reply with the three items above, I’ll run a unit-price mapping for Marketplace SKUs with Aditya and share a proposed private-offer price ladder for AWS/GCP/Azure. If procurement needs to be looped in now, feel free to CC them.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachments: redwood-pricing-scenario.xlsx (pricing bands, scenarios)

From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@brightcart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: marketplace private offer discussion + quick ask on volumes/targets

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap and the spreadsheet. Quick answers below from our side:

1) Estimated monthly token volume (first 6 months): 90M-150M tokens (we expect to be on the higher end if the POC results look good).
2) Budget range: roughly $8,000–$18,000 / month for inference initially, with potential to expand after Q2.
3) Target unit economics: we’re targeting ~ $75 / 1M tokens as the ideal upper bound for the private offer. If we can get to $50–$75 / 1M that’d be great.
4) Preferred marketplace: AWS Marketplace private offer is preferred for procurement simplicity. Procurement has asked for the private-offer template and standard DOCS checklist — I’m attaching our procurement requirements PDF.

We’re OK with Redwood mapping pricing across AWS/GCP/Azure so we can compare. Please loop in your marketplace/partner contacts for AWS private offers.

—
Ethan Park
Head of Product (AI) | BrightCart
ethan.park@brightcart.com
Attachments: BrightCart_procurement_requirements.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@brightcart.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: marketplace private offer discussion + quick ask on volumes/targets

Perfect — thanks for the details, Ethan. That range gives us enough to propose a staged private-offer ladder. Next steps from our side:

- Aditya and I will produce a Marketplace unit-price mapping (AWS/GCP/Azure) that normalizes for marketplace fees and gives equivalent $/1M-token bands. We’ll include a recommended starting private-offer unit price and two discounted tiers once you hit higher commit bands.
- We’ll populate the AWS Marketplace Private Offer template and share a version you can review with procurement.
- If BrightCart confirms intent to proceed after reviewing the mapping, we can kick off a short procurement timeline (DocuSign + PO) — typical turnaround is 2-3 weeks once pricing is agreed.

I’ve attached the AWS template and a CSV with the initial mapping we’ll use as a base: aws-marketplace-private-offer-template.docx, marketplace-unit-price-mapping.csv. Aditya — assigning to you to run marketplace fee adjustments and return a normalized $/1M table by EOD Tue. Rafael — can you review the proposed discount tiers for contract/legal implications?

Ethan — will the $75 / 1M target be acceptable as our starting negotiation point for the private offer? If yes, we’ll aim to propose a slightly higher list price plus private-offer unit price at or below $75 so procurement can see the savings.

Thanks —
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachments: aws-marketplace-private-offer-template.docx, marketplace-unit-price-mapping.csv

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 15:32:00 -0800
Subject: RE: AWS/GCP/Azure Marketplace private offer pricing — unit price mapping (BrightCart)

Thanks — quick internal note. I reviewed the initial mapping CSV and have a couple of asks before we share with BrightCart procurement:

- Confirm marketplace take rates we used for each cloud (AWS 15%, GCP 12%, Azure 14%) — Aditya, can you include the source/line items for those %s in the next version?
- Add an alternate ladder that starts at $90 / 1M as the listed SKU and private-offer unit price at $75 / 1M for the lowest commit band (this makes the savings visible).
- Add a short one-pager summary that procurement can consume quickly (pricing summary + contract term highlights).

Aditya — please update by EOD Tue and drop the files into the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-marketplace-pricing. Marissa — I’ll review legal/contract side once the updated ladder is in the folder.

-Rafael
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com
